card.name: Hazard and utility text, mixed words
card.fires_on: Scattered ordinary words (according, to, the, used, commas) in web text about nuclear plants, water, storms and hazardous chemicals. The marked word is often a small linking word before a fact or a clause.

modes.label: Nuclear and water-use reporting

modes.example: Palo Verde uses treated sewage water from Phoenix, instead of fresh water,<< to>> meet its cooling needs.

modes.example: Do not take shelter under or near trees<<,>> flagpoles, or light poles.

card.writes: It lowers the chance that safety words come next, with no clear boost to any one word.
card.plain: It fires on small linking words in text about hazards and plants, and it makes the model less likely to write the word safety next.
